title: Closed subsets consisting of closed points
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over a field $K$. A closed
subset of $X$ all of whose points are
closed is a finite set of points.

proof.text: Let $E\subseteq X$ be the given closed subset. Since $K$ is a field, $\operatorname{Spec}K$ is Noetherian. The structure morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is of finite type, so [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] implies that $X$ is a Noetherian scheme.

source.place: Lemma 01T6 (lemma-finite-type-noetherian), with the Noetherianity of Spec K

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-noetherian-closed-points-finite] to the Noetherian scheme $X$ and the closed subset $E$. Its hypothesis that every point of $E$ is closed is exactly the hypothesis here, so it concludes that $E$ is finite.
